FN-TBB3G95-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 255
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 255 as introduced could increase obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an estimated-maximum of $657,500 annually by allowing State Police Tier
II plan members to receive payment for any accrued and unused annual leave in excess of 480
hours, up to a maximum of 80 hours per year.
Page 1

FN-TBB3G95-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 255
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/09/2025
House Bill 255 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund could increase
obligations of the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by an estimated-maximum
of $1.2 million annually by allowing any law enforcement officer employed by ALEA to receive
payment for any accrued and unused annual leave in excess of 480 hours, up to a maximum of
80 hours per year.
